effect.$description: Theme-independent visual effect roles composed by application and catalogue recipes.

material.$description: Backdrop-only material tuning. Semantic foreground and fill vibrancy are separate colour ingredients selected by the renderer.

reduced.$description: No backdrop chroma amplification in reduced-transparency, increased-contrast, and forced-colour environments.

enhanced.$description: Explicit stronger backdrop chroma for decorative material contexts with verified contrast.

wideGamut.$description: P3-capability material lift applied by renderers as a progressive enhancement.

highDynamicRange.$description: HDR-capability material lift applied by renderers only behind dynamic-range support gates.
